theme_and_context.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Archetype 4) mixed with Technical Retro-Futurism
theme_and_context.vibe: Objective, rigid, functional, highly polished, zero-noise, cognition-first minimalism.

typography.strategy: Cognition-first minimalism. Strict hierarchy. No generic rounded sans.

fonts.display: Unbounded (for App Name/Logo and major marketing headers only)
fonts.headings: Satoshi (tight tracking, e.g., tracking-tight or tracking-tighter)
fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono (CRITICAL: Use extensively for API keys, usage numbers, code snippets, and data tables)

rules: Use mono extensively for 'developer' context to reinforce the technical vibe.
Apply subtle negative tracking for larger headings (-0.02em to -0.04em).

colors.strategy: Near-black canvas with layered surfaces in single-digit luminance steps. Depth comes from subtle borders and brightness, not shadows.
rules: Never use pure white (#FFFFFF) for large background areas.
Accent color should be used extremely sparingly (active states, primary CTAs).
Use border lines for hierarchy, not drop shadows.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: Mode B: High Density Grid. Information-dense, scannable sections.
structure: Top Navigation: Extremely minimal. Height 64px, border-b border-white/5, transparent background with backdrop-blur.
Main Content: Max-width 1200px, centered, generous top padding (pt-12).
Bento Grid for Overview Widgets (Quota, Wallet, Alerts): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 or 4, gap-4.
API Keys Table: Full width section below widgets.
grids_and_layouts.surface_treatment: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. Cards have 1px borders, flat background, no rounded corners or max rounded-sm (2px to 4px). NO large border-radius.

components.Header: Frasberg text logo (Unbounded) + 'Developer Console' (Satoshi, text-secondary). Right side: User avatar/menu.
components.Quota_Chip: Small dense pill (JetBrains Mono). If close to limit, show warning color. Click to trigger Upgrade modal.
components.API_Keys_Table: Use Shadcn Table but customize: border-collapse, thin borders. 'Reveal' button should be a ghost button. Key values in JetBrains Mono. Include 'Revoke' (destructive ghost action).
components.Upgrade_Modal: Minimalist dialog. Show Free/Pro/Scale tiers. Highlight 'Scale via PayPal'. Recommend importing 'react-icons/fa' for FaPaypal.
components.Usage_Stats: Recharts AreaChart or LineChart. Remove grid lines and axes for a sparkline look, or keep them extremely faint (stroke='rgba(255,255,255,0.05)'). Line color is accent (#00F0FF).
components.Wallet_Card: Auto top-up pool. Show balance in huge mono font (text-4xl JetBrains Mono tracking-tighter).
components.Docs_Snippet: Darker inset area (bg-[#050505] border border-white/5 p-4). Syntax highlighted cURL command. Copy button.

rules: Optimistic UI: interactions should feel instant.
Hover states: Change background brightness (e.g., bg-white/[0.02] to bg-white/[0.06]), NOT shadows.
Focus states: 1px solid accent color ring.
The 'Tracing Beam': Apply to the active API key row or the Upgrade Pro card for a high-tech feel.

libraries.animations: framer-motion (use for subtle presence animations, not bouncy)

rules: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='create-key-button', data-testid='upgrade-paypal-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign the developer dashboard at /dashboard to strictly follow the 'Emergent' visual style (Vercel/Linear vibes).
Override the existing `lux-bg`, `lux-surface`, and `lux-border` CSS variables in your component or globally to use the deep blacks and subtle grays defined in this palette.
Implement the specific components requested: Header, Quota chip with Upgrade modal (PayPal), API Keys table (create, reveal, revoke), Usage stats, Wallet/Auto top-up, and Docs quickstart snippet.
Ensure the Shadcn UI components (Card, Table, Dialog, Button) are customized to have sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm) and thin borders, overriding any default heavy radii.
Inject JetBrains Mono for all numeric data, API keys, and terminal snippets.
Use Recharts for the Usage Stats with a minimalist, un-decorated sparkline style.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create a clean, brutalist-yet-polished 'Emergent' look similar to Vercel or Linear.
DO NOT use large gradients, heavy shadows, or generic card designs.
Use JetBrains Mono for anything data-heavy (keys, usage limits, stats).
Make sure the Shadcn Table component uses `border-collapse` and removes the default heavy rounded corners. Use `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`.
Ensure the Docs quickstart snippet actually shows a `curl` example using the user's API key (mocked or dynamically generated).
